_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Forty-first scheduled run. 16 of 22 URLs served and 10,363 product pages reviewed, a new high.

ERGONZI: the 06:05 pull failed on a connection reset by peer, but the site was serving -- a direct check minutes later returned HTTP 200 on its home page and its Shopify feed. A transient fault on one request, not an outage and not a block, and the third such episode across the roster after Your Roses' TLS alert on 2026-10-29. Re-pulled with --only and merged: 520 products, all 33 of its cases present. Recorded as checked because it served, not because a retry was attempted.

ONE NEW CASE: HILLSIDERO-007, "Royal Park 皇家园林 (Netherlands)", matching the chart entry "Royal Park (2666367 flower bulbs)" -- To Be Filed, so no enforceable right -- classified Strong. This is the first match produced by the 2026-11-03 parenthetical fix on a listing that did not already exist: Hillside Rose Farm grew 157 -> 165 products over the weekend and this is one of the additions. Captured the same morning.

HILLSIDERO-005 is back after four runs absent (2026-11-03 to 11-06), each confirmed by HTTP 404. That is its seventh return since 2026-10-19 and the longest absence it has returned from.

Six listings stand removed, each confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001, HILLSIDERO-004 and SPRINGLAND-004. 451 of 462 cases verified present.

The five Commerce Farms cases were left untouched again: nothing here can re-verify an Etsy listing, and their Last Verified dates still say only that the user saw those listings on 2026-11-03.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the tenth consecutive run (787 / 48 each). Still flagged with the user, still not acted on.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.

Etsy storefront, added to the roster 2026-11-03. Etsy publishes no open product feed and etsy.com is unreachable from this environment (HTTP 403 at the proxy's CONNECT stage), so this seller cannot be crawled and is a standing coverage gap. Its five cases, COMMERCEFA-001..005, were built on 2026-11-03 from listing URLs and screenshots the user gathered by hand; they are not re-verified by this run and their Last Verified dates deliberately did not move.

The scheduled 06:05 pull failed on a connection reset by peer. A direct check minutes later found the site serving normally -- HTTP 200 on its home page and on its Shopify product feed -- so this was a transient fault on one request, not an outage and not a block. The site was re-pulled at about 06:07 with --only and merged into this run: 520 products, all 33 of its cases re-verified present. Reported as checked because it actually served.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 216 products, unchanged. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 174 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-005 still present; -004 still removed (HTTP 404).
Shopify storefront; the store's own product feed answered normally and returned zero products. The catalog is empty, not unreachable -- the site was checked in full.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 1,943 products, up 56 from 2026-10-26 and 88 over three runs. None of the additions matched a chart name.

screenshot_limitation: 404 of 462 cases carry a screenshot, including HILLSIDERO-007 captured today. The 58 without one each record why: High Garden 52 (8 Registered) -- the seller's pages blank themselves on detecting an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 (1 Registered) -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed, HTTP 404.
